## Performer reference and vocal timing

Realistic solo music videos now use the isolated lead vocal to guide the singer’s mouth while preserving the approved song for playback. When you bring a performer back, Video Studio selects clear reference views of the same performer from the saved clip. It keeps five-second hooks and explicit continuous-camera shots together and can place cutaways in longer instrumental gaps.

[Source commit 971cd66](https://github.com/CaleMediaDev/cale-ai-workbench/commit/971cd66682a34e8a8adfda673ea1ed67d126bb16)

Tested on the same approved five-second country recording with identical playback audio. A fresh country-song generation also retained the lead vocal through the audio review screen.
